# video6 reconstruction report (round 001)

Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-equivalent protocol).

## Observed in the 24 reference samples
- A single continuous low-angle follow shot (no cuts observed between samples): a small child in a red sweater and blue overalls rides a tricycle (big black front wheel, two small black rear wheels, tall blue seatback, red frame, chrome handlebar with red grips) away from camera.
- 0-7.3 s: straight down a long cream hotel corridor with orange/brown/red hexagon carpet, dark doors both sides, round ceiling lamps; red elevator doors on left and a green stairwell doorway on right at the start.
- ~8.3-10.5 s: corridor opens into a lounge; the child turns left onto a wood floor.
- ~10.5-13.6 s: rides across a red/orange patterned rug toward a staircase alcove wall; armchairs, plants, chandelier, sconces.
- ~14-16.7 s: turns right through a passage, camera close and seeing the rider's left side; then faces a corridor wall with a door.
- ~16.7-23 s: turns right and rides along a second hex-carpet corridor toward an end wall with a door, plant and red fire bell; camera lower and nearly level.
- ~23-24 s: begins a right turn at the corridor end.

## Model
- Environment: boxes/planes for corridors, lounge, passage, doors, baseboards, lamps (emissive), plants (pot cylinder + foliage ellipsoid), chairs, rug; procedural in-memory DataTextures for the hex carpet and rug.
- Tricycle: articulated hierarchy - steering group (yaw from path curvature), spinning front wheel with cranks/pedals, spinning rear wheels.
- Child: pelvis, torso with lean/sway, head with hair, arms aimed shoulder-to-grip each frame, legs solved with analytic two-bone IK to the pedal positions (pedalling tied to distance travelled).
- Motion: analytic path (straights + circular arcs) with distance-vs-time keyframes anchored to sample timestamps (monotone cubic). Camera follows on the path behind the rider with keyframed follow distance, height, pitch and lateral offset, yaw aimed at a point ahead of the rider.

## Inference vs observation
Path geometry, room layout outside the visible frames, and motion between samples are inferred. Speeds are estimated from apparent progress.

## Feedback
None received yet (initial round). Unverified: framing, timing of turns, lighting/colour balance.
